Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ أَحْمَدُكَ وَ أَنْتَ لِلْحَمْدِ أَهْلٌ
Translation: My God, I praise You, and You are worthy of praise

Arabic text: عَلَى حُسْنِ صَنِيعِكَ إِلَيَّ، وَ سُبُوغِ نَعْمَائِكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: For Your excellent favor to me, and the abundance of Your blessings upon me

Arabic text: وَ جَزِيلِ عَطَائِكَ عِنْدِي
Translation: And Your generous giving to me

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى مَا فَضَّلْتَنِيْ بِهِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And for that with which You have favored me from Your mercy

Arabic text: وَ أَسْبَغْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ نِعْمَتِكَ
Translation: And bestowed upon me from Your blessings

Arabic text: فَقَدِ اصْطَنَعْتَ عِنْدِيْ مَا يَعْجِزُ عَنْهُ شُكْرِيْ وَ لَوْ لَا إِحْسَانُكَ إِلَيَّ
Translation: You have done for me what my gratitude fails to encompass, and were it not for Your kindness to me

Arabic text: وَ سُبُوغُ نَعْمَائِكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And the abundance of Your blessings upon me

Arabic text: مَا بَلَغْتُ إِحْرَازَ حَظِّيْ، وَ لَا إِصْلَاحَ نَفْسِي
Translation: I would not have attained my portion, nor reformed myself

Arabic text: وَ لٰكِنَّكَ ابْتَدَأْتَنِيْ بِالْإِحْسَانِ
Translation: But You began with me with kindness

Arabic text: وَ رَزَقْتَنِيْ فِيْ أُمُورِيْ كُلِّهَا الْكِفَايَةَ
Translation: And provided me sufficiency in all my affairs

Arabic text: وَ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّيْ جَهْدَ الْبَلَاءِ
Translation: And averted from me severe trials

Arabic text: وَ مَنَعْتَ مِنِّيْ مَحْذُورَ الْقَضَاءِ
Translation: And protected me from the dangers of fate

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلَاءٍ جَاهِدٍ قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي
Translation: My God, how many severe afflictions have You turned away from me

Arabic text: وَ كَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ سَابِغَةٍ أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي
Translation: And how many abundant blessings have You given to delight my eyes

Arabic text: وَ كَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَةٍ كَرِيمَةٍ لَكَ عِنْدِي
Translation: And how many noble favors You have done for me

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الِاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي
Translation: You are the One who answered my call in times of desperation

Arabic text: وَ أَقَلْتَ عِنْدَ الْعِثَارِ زَلَّتِي
Translation: And overlooked my slip when I stumbled

Arabic text: وَ أَخَذْتَ لِيْ مِنَ الْأَعْدَاءِ بِظُلَامَتِي
Translation: And took my right from my enemies when I was wronged

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلًا حِيْنَ سَأَلْتُكَ
Translation: My God, I have never found You stingy when I asked You

Arabic text: وَ لَا مُنْقَبِضًا حِيْنَ أَرَدْتُكَ
Translation: Nor withdrawn when I sought You

Arabic text: بَلْ وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَائِيْ سَامِعًا، وَ لِمَطَالِبِيْ مُعْطِيًا
Translation: Rather, I found You listening to my prayers, and granting my requests

Arabic text: وَ وَجَدْتُ نُعْمَاكَ عَلَيَّ سَابِغَةً
Translation: And I found Your blessings upon me abundant

Arabic text: فِيْ كُلِّ شَأْنٍ مِنْ شَأْنِيْ وَ كُلِّ زَمَانٍ مِنْ زَمَانِي
Translation: In every aspect of my affairs and in every period of my time

Arabic text: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِيْ مَحْمُودٌ، وَ صَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ
Translation: So You are praised by me, and Your favor to me is recognized

Arabic text: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِيْ وَ لِسَانِيْ وَ عَقْلِيْ، حَمْدًا يَبْلُغُ الْوَفَاءَ وَ حَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ
Translation: My soul, my tongue, and my mind praise You with praise that reaches true fulfillment and genuine gratitude

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَكُونُ مَبْلَغَ رِضَاكَ عَنِّي
Translation: Praise that reaches the extent of Your satisfaction with me

Arabic text: فَنَجِّنِيْ مِنْ سَخْطِكَ يَا كَهْفِيْ حِيْنَ تُعْيِينِيَ الْمَذَاهِبُ
Translation: So save me from Your anger, O my refuge when all paths exhaust me

Arabic text: وَ يَا مُقِيلِيْ عَثْرَتِي
Translation: O Forgiver of my stumbles

Arabic text: فَلَوْ لَا سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِيْ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِيْنَ
Translation: Were it not for Your concealment of my faults, I would have been among the disgraced

Arabic text: وَ يَا مُؤَيِّدِيْ بِالنَّصْرِ
Translation: O my Supporter with victory

Arabic text: فَلَوْ لَا نَصْرُكَ إِيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ
Translation: Were it not for Your help to me, I would have been among the defeated

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلَى أَعْنَاقِهَا
Translation: O You before whom kings place the yoke of humiliation on their necks

Arabic text: فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَ يَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى
Translation: They are in fear of Your power, O Possessor of righteousness

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى، أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي
Translation: O You who has the most beautiful names, I ask You to pardon me

Arabic text: وَ تَغْفِرَ لِيْ فَلَسْتُ بَرِيئًا فَأَعْتَذِرَ
Translation: And forgive me, for I am not innocent that I should apologize

Arabic text: وَ لَا بِذِيْ قُوَّةٍ فَأَنْتَصِرَ
Translation: Nor do I have power that I might prevail

Arabic text: وَ لَا مَفَرَّ لِيْ فَأَفِرَّ وَ أَسْتَقِيلُكَ عَثَرَاتِي
Translation: And I have no escape to flee to, and I ask You to overlook my missteps

Arabic text: وَ أَتَنَصَّلُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِيَ الَّتِيْ قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي
Translation: And I seek absolution from You for my sins which have ruined me

Arabic text: وَ أَحَاطَتْ بِيْ فَأَهْلَكَتْنِي
Translation: And surrounded me to destroy me

Arabic text: مِنْهَا فَرَرْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ تَائِبًا
Translation: From them I have fled to You, my Lord, in repentance

Arabic text: فَتُبْ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَوِّذًا فَأَعِذْنِيْ مُسْتَجِيرًا
Translation: So accept my repentance; seeking refuge, so protect me; seeking shelter

Arabic text: فَلَا تَخْذُلْنِيْ سَائِلًا فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِيْ مُعْتَصِمًا
Translation: So do not forsake me; asking, so do not deprive me; seeking protection

Arabic text: فَلَا تُسْلِمْنِيْ دَاعِيًا فَلَا تَرُدَّنِيْ خَائِبًا
Translation: So do not abandon me; calling, so do not turn me away disappointed

Arabic text: دَعَوْتُكَ يَا رَبِّ مِسْكِينًا، مُسْتَكِينًا
Translation: I have called upon You, O Lord, as one poor, humble

Arabic text: مُشْفِقًا، خَائِفًا، وَجِلًا، فَقِيرًا، مُضْطَرًّا إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Fearful, afraid, anxious, destitute, desperate for You

Arabic text: أَشْكُوْ إِلَيْكَ يَا إِلَهِيْ ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي
Translation: I complain to You, my God, of my soul's weakness

Arabic text: عَنِ الْمُسَارَعَةِ فِيمَا وَعَدْتَهُ أَوْلِيَاءَكَ
Translation: In hastening toward what You have promised Your friends

Arabic text: وَ الْمُجَانَبَةِ عَمَّا حَذَّرْتَهُ أَعْدَاءَكَ
Translation: And in avoiding what You have warned Your enemies against

Arabic text: وَ كَثْرَةَ هُمُومِيْ، وَ وَسْوَسَةَ نَفْسِي
Translation: And my many worries, and the whisperings of my soul

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ لَمْ تَفْضَحْنِيْ بِسَرِيرَتِي
Translation: My God, You have not exposed my secrets

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ تُهْلِكْنِيْ بِجَرِيرَتِيْ، أَدْعُوكَ فَتُجِيبُنِي
Translation: And have not destroyed me for my sins. I call upon You and You answer me

Arabic text: وَ إِنْ كُنْتُ بَطِيئًا حِيْنَ تَدْعُونِي
Translation: Even when I am slow to respond when You call me

Arabic text: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ كُلَّمَا شِئْتُ مِنْ حَوَائِجِي
Translation: And I ask You for whatever I wish of my needs

Arabic text: وَ حَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي
Translation: And wherever I am, I entrust my secrets to You

Arabic text: فَلَا أَدْعُوْ سِوَاكَ، وَ لَا أَرْجُوْ غَيْرَكَ
Translation: So I call upon none but You, and hope for none other than You

Arabic text: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Here I am, here I am! You hear whoever complains to You

Arabic text: وَ تَلْقَى مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: And You meet whoever relies upon You

Arabic text: وَ تُخَلِّصُ مَنِ اعْتَصَمَ بِكَ
Translation: And You deliver whoever seeks refuge in You

Arabic text: وَ تُفَرِّجُ عَمَّنْ لَاذَ بِكَ
Translation: And You relieve whoever seeks Your protection

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِيْ خَيْرَ الْآخِرَةِ وَ الْأُولَى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي
Translation: My God, do not deprive me of the good of the Hereafter and this world due to my lack of gratitude

Arabic text: وَ اغْفِرْ لِيْ مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
Translation: And forgive me for what You know of my sins

Arabic text: إِنْ تُعَذِّبْ فَأَنَا الظَّالِمُ، الْمُفَرِّطُ
Translation: If You punish me, then I am the wrongdoer, the negligent

Arabic text: اَلْمُضَيِّعُ، الْآثِمُ، الْمُقَصِّرُ، الْمُضَجِّعُ
Translation: The waster, the sinner, the deficient, the indifferent

Arabic text: اَلْمُغْفِلُ حَظَّ نَفْسِي
Translation: The one heedless of my soul's portion

Arabic text: وَ إِنْ تَغْفِرْ فَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: And if You forgive me, then You are the Most Merciful of the merciful
